summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes 727 KB obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall lifecycle script (`node setup.mjs`) checks for a local `bun` binary and, if absent, downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and uses it to execute a bundled `math_init.js` file via `execFileSync`. The invoked `math_init.js` is a single-line ~727 KB script using obfuscator.io-style string-array plus array-shuffle indirection (large numeric/character array, a rotator function, hex-named identifiers) so that URLs and behaviors are reconstructed only at runtime and are not statically resolvable. The alien-runtime hop causes the payload to be executed outside Node's module graph, bypassing tools that trace only Node-resolved code. The package name presents as a test/monorepo scaffold, which does not match shipping and executing a large obfuscated blob via a freshly-downloaded second language runtime at install time. This is the alternate-runtime dropper shape: install-time execution of an opaque payload delivered through a runtime the package itself pulls in.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
